title: refactor: merge duplicate CredentialStore and resolve_secret_uri
description:
stoa-1490b957.2 and u02k.3 are deferred P1 items from the secretx review: two parallel CredentialStore implementations exist (one in transit, one in reader) and both mains duplicate the resolve_secret_uri helper. These must be kept in sync manually, which is a compounding maintenance liability.

Why this exists: the two daemons were built out independently; shared secret-handling code was never extracted to a common location.

What needs to be done:
1. Extract a shared stoa-secrets (or stoa-config-common) crate, or add the shared logic to stoa-core under a feature flag.
2. Move resolve_secret_uri into the shared location and delete both copies in transit/main.rs and reader/main.rs.
3. Merge the two CredentialStore implementations into a single implementation, parameterised by the secretx backend.
4. Ensure both daemons compile and all existing tests pass with the refactored paths.

Adopts deferred issues: stoa-1490b957.2, stoa-1490b957.3.
notes: Review converged after 1 round. Final review: stoa-45f3f588. Follow-up epic filed: stoa-97adb45e (ClientCertStore dedup).
